technical_rounds.key_insight: Interviewers test the candidate's ability to frame business problems mathematically. The Communique handbook 'The Guessing Game' is the definitive preparation resource.

Gradient descent mathematical proofs and convergence analysis
Feature engineering strategies for financial data
Model interpretability in production credit scoring systems

preparation_strategy.dual_degree_advantage: Dual Degree (B.Tech + M.Tech) candidates consistently receive preferential shortlisting for this role due to deeper research capability expectations.
